title: Push step-count axis: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^18 -> 2^17
description: Halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^18 to 2^17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 (grad_accum_steps=1), doubling optimizer steps again on top of the round-2 batch-size win; all other hyperparameters (ASPECT_RATIO=96, DEPTH=8, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1, MATRIX_LR=0.04) unchanged.
reflection: The step-count trend extrapolates further than the group assumed was likely (round-3 messages speculated 2^18 was near a plateau). val_bpb 0.978063 vs baseline 0.982306 is a clean ~0.43% win, well outside this cell's observed noise band (~0.0002-0.0003 for identical configs). Peak VRAM dropped a lot too (33.2GB vs 63.9GB) since DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE halved with grad_accum_steps=1 - there's now headroom to explore whether an even smaller TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE (2^16) continues the trend, though at some point per-microbatch noise or compile/launch overhead per step should dominate and reverse the gain. Worth a slot next round to test 2^16, but also worth being cautious about how many more halvings actually help before hitting a wall like the width axis did at ASPECT_RATIO=128.
